🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: cyclicals leading (Energy and Industrials producing multiple ABOVE TREND names) and Financials showing strength (JPM ABOVE TREND), but note MAJOR divergence across several large tech names—watch for trend break.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: SLB (1W: +15.90% | 1M: +16.64%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.09%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +8.37% | 1M: +8.05%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: LMT (1W: +5.91% | 1M: +14.50%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +5.40% | 1M: +12.63%) ABOVE TREND. Materials showing strength: DOW (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +4.80%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging overall: AAPL (1W: -2.25% | 1M: -5.94%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.05% | 1M: -1.02%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -1.26% | 1M: +4.76%) CORRECTION. Healthcare weak: JNJ (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -0.50%) BELOW TREND, AMGN (1W: -3.67% | 1M: -7.15%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples under pressure: CL (1W: -3.51% | 1M: -1.62%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: SLB (1W: +15.90% | 1M: +16.64%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +10.10% | 1M: +1.99%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +9.57% | 1M: +0.09%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.09%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +8.76% | 1M: -10.03%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Energy) — cyclical/value concentration.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: MCD (1W: -3.48% | 1M: -2.55%) BELOW TREND, CL (1W: -3.51% | 1M: -1.62%) BELOW TREND, AMGN (1W: -3.67% | 1M: -7.15%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -3.69% | 1M: +7.52%) CORRECTION, NOW (1W: -4.09% | 1M: -11.39%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in defensive staples and select tech names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W moves: SLB (1W: +15.90% | 1M: +16.64%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +10.10% | 1M: +1.99%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +9.57% | 1M: +0.09%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.09%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +8.76% | 1M: -10.03%) RECOVERY. Major divergence flagged: NVDA (1W: -1.26% | 1M: +4.76%) CORRECTION, CRM (1W: -3.69% | 1M: +7.52%) CORRECTION, ADBE (1W: -6.29% | 1M: +1.46%) CORRECTION, TSLA (1W: -4.95% | 1M: +1.10%) CORRECTION — suppress strong regime conviction until follow-through.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed to weak with short-term exhaustion. AMAT (1W: +8.56% | 1M: +5.84%) ABOVE TREND is a bright spot, while AAPL (1W: -2.25% | 1M: -5.94%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -3.05% | 1M: -1.02%) BELOW TREND show downside; NVDA (1W: -1.26% | 1M: +4.76%) CORRECTION signals rotation within the group.

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive: JPM (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.02%) ABOVE TREND and XOM-adjacent financial flows support the cyclical bid; V (1W: -0.34% | 1M: +7.34%) CORRECTION shows 1M strength. Financials contributing to the RISK-ON tilt.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Soft overall with pockets of strength. UNH (1W: +3.07% | 1M: +1.36%) ABOVE TREND contrasts with JNJ (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -0.50%) BELOW TREND and GILD (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -4.73%) BELOW TREND; monitor drug/approval headlines for directional catalysts.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclicals/value exposure given Energy and Industrials strength (SLB, CVX, CAT, BA) and Financials resilience (JPM); reduce exposure to extended/uncertain tech names showing CORRECTION (NVDA, CRM, ADBE). Style: Value/Cyclical favored while monitoring tech divergence for tactical entry.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: SLB (1W: +15.90% | 1M: +16.64%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.09%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.02%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ADBE (1W: -6.29% | 1M: +1.46%) CORRECTION, TSLA (1W: -4.95% | 1M: +1.10%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -3.05% | 1M: -1.02%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (Breadth: showing sector strength, multiple ABOVE TREND leaders). BEARISH: Technology (Sector weakness/rotation signs) and Consumer Staples (stretched defensives showing weakness).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Monitor SLB for continuation above recent highs as ABOVE TREND confirmation; watch NVDA (1W: -1.26% | 1M: +4.76%) CORRECTION for failure vs. follow-through; JPM (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.02%) ABOVE TREND for cyclical breadth expansion.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
NVDA (+55): Nvidia partner deal—NVDA (1W: -1.26% | 1M: +4.76%) CORRECTION; news positive but price shows short-term distribution. JPM (+50): price target bump—JPM (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.02%) ABOVE TREND; sentiment confirmed. SLB (+50): Venezuela-driven volatility—SLB (1W: +15.90% | 1M: +16.64%) ABOVE TREND; sentiment confirmed and driving sector leadership. CRM (+50): analyst upgrades—CRM (1W: -3.69% | 1M: +7.52%) CORRECTION; news bullish but price on short-term pullback (watch for follow-through).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ADBE (-50): downgrade headlines—ADBE (1W: -6.29% | 1M: +1.46%) CORRECTION; sentiment aligns with price weakness. (Other notable negative sentiment names lack dual-timeframe data here; monitor NFLX and SO headlines separately for confirmation.)

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, Value/Cyclical style favored given Energy and Industrials leadership (Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive). SLB (1W: +15.90% | 1M: +16.64%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.09%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.02%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence among large-cap techs (NVDA, CRM, ADBE, TSLA in CORRECTION) and mixed sentiment—monitor for trend confirmation before adding to growth exposure.
